# Test fixtures

`library-visitors-chart.png` is a bar chart made with matplotlib to test VisionScribe. The library and visitor counts are invented. The image is released under the repository's MIT license.

The chart shows monthly visitors rising from 3,200 in January to 7,400 in December 2025. June drops to 2,100 and is labeled "Closed 2 weeks for roof repair". Good alt text names the upward trend and explains the June dip.
